propositions: Add commit_and_push_tickets_branch entrypoint to stage, commit, and push a dirty tracker with optional supplied or ambient git identity before delegating to push_tickets_branch.

Acquire existing write lock before inspecting dirty tree; reuse check_no_rebase_in_progress to block merge-recovery state: strict mode raises PushDeliveryError with merge-recovery-blocked reason; default mode logs warning and returns without staging or pushing.
Inspect dirty tree under lock, stage all tracker changes, and commit only when dirty; apply supplied identity via git -c user.name/user.email and never mutate global or repository config.

Always delegate to push_tickets_branch after optional-commit phase unconditionally, even when tree is clean, because locally-ahead HEAD still needs delivery; under strict mode persistent rejection raises PushDeliveryError; default mode warns and returns without push.

Raise dependency-defined PushDeliveryError with stable commit-lock-timeout, stage-failed, and commit-failed reasons on strict lock/staging/commit failures; default mode logs warning, returns without push, and retains uncommitted content for later retry.

Extend private CLI adapter with commit-and-push action accepting tracker, message, optional strict, and optional author-name/author-email flags; retain existing push action unchanged and share single PushDeliveryError translation boundary.
